title: Polymorphism trampoline must wrap a model serializer only once; the generic CombinedSerializer build path must not wrap again
answers: why is the polymorphism trampoline applied twice to model serializers
where does pydantic-core wrap serializers in the polymorphism trampoline
serialize_as_any / subclass serialization goes through two trampoline layers
should I call maybe_wrap_in_polymorphism_trampoline after find_serializer
body:
Invariant: a serializer gets wrapped by `CombinedSerializer::maybe_wrap_in_polymorphism_trampoline` (pydantic-core/src/serializers/shared.rs) exactly once.
In the generic build path in `impl CombinedSerializer`, the result of `Self::find_serializer(type_, schema, config, definitions)` is now returned as-is. Before this PR it was also passed through `maybe_wrap_in_polymorphism_trampoline`, so model serializers got wrapped twice (the follow-up to pydantic PR #13522 that pointed this out).
If you add a new serializer type that needs polymorphic (subclass) dispatch, wrap it once at the place that already does the wrapping. Do not add a wrap at the shared `find_serializer` call site.
If you skip this, you get an extra trampoline layer: double dispatch and extra overhead when serializing each model.
applies: pydantic-core Rust serializer construction (serializers/shared.rs CombinedSerializer build/find_serializer) and polymorphic/subclass serialization
